name: AI experience improvement
description: Repeatedly observe a real AI experience through a bounded adapter and retain structured evidence for supervised improvements.

parameters.label: Evaluation name
parameters.tooltip: Name the build that OpenOrbit creates for this recurring evaluation.

parameters.label: Evaluator workspace
parameters.tooltip: Absolute path to the local repository or workspace that this evaluation may inspect.

parameters.label: AI adapter command
parameters.tooltip: Command OpenOrbit invokes for one bounded AI-adapter action. It must return before OpenOrbit schedules another iteration.

parameters.label: User experience goal
parameters.placeholder: e.g. help users resolve a billing question safely
parameters.tooltip: The user outcome that the external AI adapter should evaluate or improve.

parameters.label: AI model profile name
parameters.tooltip: Name for the model profile that this Quick Start creates and assigns to the build.

parameters.label: AI provider
parameters.tooltip: Select the provider that serves the supervisor model.

parameters.label: Model / deployment
parameters.tooltip: Provider model ID or deployment name used for evaluation.

parameters.label: Provider endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Provider base endpoint. Azure OpenAI requires this; Bedrock can leave it blank.

parameters.label: Region
parameters.tooltip: Cloud region used by the selected provider, such as eastus or us-east-1.

parameters.label: API key environment variable
parameters.tooltip: Name of the environment variable that holds the provider API key or credentials.

prompt_template.name: ${build_name} policy
prompt_template.content: Review the retained AI experience evidence for ${experience_goal}. Identify only evidence-backed user harm, friction, or regressions and propose reversible improvements.

cases.name: ${experience_goal}
cases.acceptance: Return structured evidence, risks, and an explicit next check.

build.name: ${build_name}
build.purpose: Continuously learn from a real AI experience: ${experience_goal}.
